data_ownership_probe.mechanism_finding: The probe previously measured the declared anchor with a single (anchor,'=',False) leaf. Odoo translates that leaf to a predicate on the joined segment, so a dotted anchor dropped every row whose head relation is empty even though the installed ceiling rule carries an explicit (head,'=',False) branch. The measurement now decomposes the anchor into head-missing plus joined-owner-null, reconciles that against the raw left-join scan, and records the dotted-leaf translation as a checked fact. The corrected totals reproduce the owner's ruling figures exactly (50,284 / 26,237 / 76,521).
